ambient_events: A door down the hall closes with the finality of a lock turning.
The amber emergency light hums and dims by a shade.
Something is cooking behind one of the doors; the smell almost reaches you.
The end-of-hall window rattles as the wind leans on it.
description: The second-floor hallway of Chrome Court, a tunnel of amber emergency light and doors painted so many times the numbers are just suggestions. The carpet is worn to jute down the center where every tenant walks the identical line. Four units open off the hall. A window at the end looks out over the district's neon, which from up here almost looks like a city that works.
name: Chrome Court — Floor 2
